title: Trees for Communities Program Wrapped Up in San Ysidro
description:
Our Trees for Communities program officially wrapped up, with our teams planting the final 12 trees in San Ysidro last month! 🌳Over the past two years, we’ve added about 2,900 trees across neighborhoods in San Diego that needed them most. 

These trees will provide shade, cleaner air and a greener future for residents for years to come. 

Thank you to everyone who helped us grow a green San Diego!
#SanDiegoAtWork
